export interface HistoryRecord {
  monitorId: number;
  timestamp: string;
  status: "online" | "offline";
  responseTime: number;
  error: string | null;
  url: string | null;
}

const unwrap = (raw: unknown): any => {
  if (raw && typeof raw === "object" && "body" in raw) return (raw as any).body;
  return raw;
};

export async function fetchMonitorHistory(monitorId: number, limit = 50): Promise<HistoryRecord[]> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/my/v1/history?monitor_id=${monitorId}&limit=${limit}`);
  const raw = await res.json();
  const data = unwrap(raw);
  if (!data || data.ok === false) {
    throw new Error(data?.error || `Failed to load history: ${res.status}`);
  }
  return Array.isArray(data.history) ? data.history : [];
}

export async function fetchRecentFailures(limit = 5): Promise<HistoryRecord[]> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/my/v1/history?recent=failures&limit=${limit}`);
  const raw = await res.json();
  const data = unwrap(raw);
  if (!data || data.ok === false) {
    throw new Error(data?.error || `Failed to load recent failures: ${res.status}`);
  }
  return Array.isArray(data.failures) ? data.failures : [];
}
